title: Leaderboard with signal and staking kept in separate columns
rule: Ranking key = signal tier (A>B>C>NA) then signal metric. Staking columns are reported alongside but cannot lift a non-A strategy above an A strategy, and points require signal tier A AND staking gates G1+G4+G5 AND G7 (price basis verified). G7 is blocked (no official price source), so points = 0 at publication (amendment A1 in data/strategies.json).

rows.note: signal tier ranks first; staking can confirm but never promote a strategy whose signal tier is not A (lucky staking cannot mask a bad signal)
